name: cgc-post-listing
description: Quartz 5 component: the site's posts, newest first, filtered to the tag on a tag page, each with its tags ringed in their colours, around their icons, from the cgc-tags engine. See README.md and CONTEXT.md.
//peerDependencies: The host Quartz's own copies, never bundled or installed here: the component's vnodes must be the host's Preact's. The types are imported for types only.
//dependencies: @chaoticgoodcomputing/icons draws each tag's icon while the site builds, with Iconify's packages, which can't all be inlined (svgo, under @iconify/tools, reads its data files at run time). So they stay out of dist/ and install here, at exactly the library's versions, which build.mjs checks (libs/icons/docs/adr/0001). MDI is one of them, pinned by this package's lockfile: nothing is fetched.
//devDependencies: Build-time only: esbuild bundles dist/, inlining our libraries and reading-time, and @chaoticgoodcomputing/css-check checks the stylesheet against ADR-0003 before it ships (build.mjs). The libraries are `file:` specs on main, which a release commit rewrites to the release's published version (ADR-0005).

quartz.name: cgc-post-listing
